title: MONTHLY ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY
THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **36 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in October 2026, spanning 26 vendors. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-109618 (PHP Group PHP)** and **CVE-2026-109619 (PHP Group PHP)**. Outside KEV, 4 further CVEs were reported exploited or tracked as zero-days by Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD or VulnCheck.
These are CISA KEV catalog counts, not a count of total cyber incidents.

**Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed PHP Group PHP (CVE-2026-109618); (2) isolate or patch exposed PHP Group PHP (CVE-2026-109619); (3) isolate or patch exposed Google Brotli (CVE-2026-111497); (4) isolate or patch exposed ISC BIND (CVE-2015-5477); (5) examine PHP Group PHP hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-109618 - PHP Group PHP use-after-free (CVSS 9.2).** PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): php 8.2.35, php 8.3.36, php 8.4.27, php 8.5.12. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Group PHP use-after-free (CVSS 9.2).** PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): php 8.2.35, php 8.3.36, php 8.4.27, php 8.5.12. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-111497 - Google Brotli out-of-bounds write (CVSS 9.2).** A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): brotli 1.0.10, brotli 1.1.1, brotli 1.2.1, node.js 22.23.4. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Sep 28: 4; week of Oct 5: 5; week of Oct 12: 9; week of Oct 19: 8; week of Oct 26: 10.
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.
**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (14 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (8 CVEs); unexpected file writes and persistence (6 CVEs).
